name: DRM, a Methodology for Research into Design
description: Introduction (design, design research, major facets, current issues with research into design, need for a methodology for research into design, DRM and its stages); research clarification (goal, types of research, success criteria, initial reference model, initial impact model); descriptive study 1 (reference model, success criteria, measurable criteria); prescriptive study (support development, impact model, support evaluation); descriptive study 2 (application evaluation, success evaluation, impact model evaluation, reference model evaluation); types and examples of research into design.
